args.content:
# Collections

A tiny library of bounded, fixed-capacity collection types.
Each collection enforces its capacity invariant explicitly and
fails loudly (throws) on invalid use rather than silently corrupting state.

Parent: [app.md](../app.md)

# Stack (src/stack.ts)

## Responsibility

`Stack<T>` is a bounded LIFO (last-in, first-out) stack with a fixed
capacity chosen at construction.

## Contract

- `constructor(capacity)` — requires a positive integer capacity;
  throws `RangeError` otherwise.
- `push(item)` — appends to the top; throws on overflow (at capacity).
- `pop()` — removes and returns the top item; throws on underflow.
- `peek()` — returns the top item without removing it; throws on
  underflow.
- `size` — current number of stored items (read-only).

## Invariants

- `0 <= size <= capacity` at all times.
- Items are ordered by insertion; `pop`/`peek` always observe the most
  recently pushed, not-yet-popped item.
- Capacity is immutable after construction.

Parent: [app.md](../app.md)

# Ring (src/ring.ts)

## Responsibility

`Ring<T>` is a fixed-capacity ring buffer implementing FIFO
(first-in, first-out) semantics over a circular backing array.

## Contract

- `constructor(capacity)` — requires a positive integer capacity;
  throws `RangeError` otherwise.
- `enqueue(item)` — appends at the tail; throws on overflow (full).
- `dequeue()` — removes and returns the oldest item; throws on
  underflow (empty).
- `peek()` — returns the oldest item without removing it; throws on
  underflow.
- `size` — current number of stored items (read-only).

## Invariants

- `0 <= size <= capacity` at all times.
- Dequeue order exactly matches enqueue order (strict FIFO).
- All operations are O(1); the backing array never grows or shifts.
- Vacated slots are cleared, so no stale references are retained.
- Capacity is immutable after construction.
